default_configuration.rationale: Retains fast provisional text; stronger local final model reduces errors on this corpus. Disclosed general technical terms improve proper-name spelling and character errors. Raw WER remains visible: LeetCode as one token costs two word edits against leet code, so hinted small.en has a higher raw WER than unhinted small.en, but lower than Vosk. Unrelated and nonspeech final outputs did not regress here.
default_configuration.remaining: One synthesized target case uses to instead of two, and two use some instead of sum. Longer speech has additional model errors; byte-exact ownership does not imply zero word errors. Nothing is claimed 100 percent accurate.
